title: IEEEXtreme 20.0
summary: A 24-hour global programming contest for teams of 2 to 3 IEEE Student Members. Solve algorithmic challenges and compete on the worldwide leaderboard.

faq.q: Who is eligible to participate in IEEEXtreme?
faq.a: Any undergraduate or graduate student at Cavendish University Uganda with an active IEEE Student Membership. Students from all faculties with coding interest are welcome.
The contest platform supports over 25 languages including C, C++, Java, Python, Go, Rust, JavaScript, Kotlin, C#, and Ruby.

faq.q: What is a Proctor and how do I get one?
faq.a: Every team must be monitored by an official IEEE Member proctor. The IEEE CUU Student Branch arranges proctors and testing rooms for all registered CUU teams.

faq.q: Will there be a physical space to code at Cavendish University?
faq.a: The Branch is exploring a 24-hour workspace for registered teams. Contact the Technical Coordinators via WhatsApp for the latest plans.
